before.context_policy: B434 injected a bounded project_context bundle but did not distinguish code, data classification and research task requirements.
before.source_graph: A successful Source Graph command with an empty JSON object could be treated as collected context.
before.delivery: Prompt injection was recorded through prompt hashes/context metadata, but worker acknowledgement was not a separate bounded contract.
before.dashboard: Process and task detail views did not expose compact per-task Source Graph/Session/AI Memory/KB telemetry.

after.context_policy: project_context validates task_type code/data_classification/research, Source Graph required/non-gating policy, exact declared targets, derived target metadata, and immutable input-shard primary context for data classification.
after.source_graph: Required code tasks fail before claim on empty Source Graph JSON hit_count=0; data-classification tasks may report Source Graph hit_count=0 when explicitly non-gating.
after.context_bundle: Source Graph, Session current-state, optional AI Memory, and KB sections carry requested/executed/hit_count/bytes/sha256/truncated/degraded metadata while raw content remains only inside the bounded prompt bundle.
after.delivery: Common Codex/Claude/DeepSeek prompts include one receipt schema; process events record injected delivery separately from bounded worker acknowledgement parsed from stdout tail.
after.dashboard: read_process_runs and task detail return compact ai_infra_context telemetry: Source Graph hits/bytes, Session hits, AI Memory hits, KB hits, injected, acknowledged, degraded reason, and deterministic byte-estimate labels only.
after.byte_metric: estimated_raw_context_vs_bundle_bytes is labeled deterministic_byte_estimate_not_token_or_cost_truth and does not assert token or cost savings.

canaries.non_empty_process_manager_source_graph: B437 fixture Source Graph bundle with sections/items produced source_graph.hit_count > 0 and exact declared target precedence over natural-language query.
canaries.required_empty_fail_before_claim: code task with Source Graph payload {} returned blocked source_graph_required_empty_result and claim_start_exact was not called.
canaries.data_task_non_gating: data_classification task with source_graph.required=false and immutable input shard returned primary_context=immutable_input_shard and source_graph.hit_count=0.
canaries.receipt_semantics: PROJECT_CONTEXT_RECEIPT with schema geoai.task_mcp.worker_context_receipt.v1 parsed acknowledged=true; injected remains delivery metadata.
canaries.dashboard_redaction: process log event containing raw_context_content=MUST_NOT_RENDER returned compact ai_infra_context and did not serialize the raw marker.
